scope: Eight diagnostic candidates newly passing nuclear QC only after a train-derived (-3,+3) model-pixel DAPI shift
panels_reviewed: shifted DAPI plus independent StarDist outlines
reviewer_decision: No image promoted to the validated classifier cohort. The fixed shift worsens raw DAPI/Hoechst spatial alignment in every reserved ORION patient.

cases.observation: The virtual DAPI is diffuse across the tissue instead of resolving the dense field of H&E nuclei; the shift does not remove this ambiguity.
Large bright virtual-DAPI spots coincide with erythrocyte-rich structures; several H&E nuclei remain dark.
Bright virtual-DAPI blobs overlap red-cell-rich structures and exceed plausible individual nuclear footprints.
Bright spots and confluent DAPI regions overlap an erythrocyte-rich field; many outlined nuclei lack distinct matched peaks.
Many DAPI peaks follow nuclear outlines, but some remain confluent. Full-marker specificity and independent fluorescence are unverified.
Dense nuclear field has broad DAPI correspondence, but several merged bright regions and unresolved individual nuclei remain.
DAPI broadly follows dense kidney nuclei, with substantial confluent signal; marker-specific validation is absent.
DAPI broadly follows dense breast nuclei but appears confluent and marker specificity is unverified.

limits: Contact sheets are display-scaled. No raw channel was changed and a numerical QC replay cannot establish biological validity. The four held fields remain excluded until further evidence.
